'''Reed Wessel''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] providing [[Weaponsmith|armstech]] training and items.
